answer.worked:
When $x=0$, $2y=0$, so $y=0$. When $x=2$,
$$\begin{align*}2+2y&=0\\2y&=-2\\y&=-1\end{align*}$$
Plot $(0,0)$ and $(2,-1)$ and draw the straight line through them.
